statement: Democratic candidates win a majority of US House seats in the 2026-11-03 midterm elections, with the Associated Press having called at least 218 of 435 seats for Democrats by 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if Associated Press race calls as of 2026-12-15 show Democratic candidates winning at least 218 of 435 US House seats in the 2026-11-03 general election. FALSE if fewer than 218 are called for Democrats.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates have been called winners in fewer than 218 US House seats as of 2026-12-15, including because races remain uncalled.

statement: US Central Command or the US Department of War (Defense) officially acknowledges US military strikes on targets inside Iran conducted between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if an official press release or on-record statement from US Central Command or the US Department of War (Defense) confirms US strikes on targets within Iranian territory or territorial waters conducted between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-15. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: US forces conduct no strikes on targets inside Iranian territory or territorial waters between 2026-10-31 and 2026-12-15.

statement: A new Israeli government wins a Knesset vote of confidence and is sworn in between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: TRUE if the Knesset approves a new government in a vote of confidence held between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-15, per the Knesset website or Reuters, AP, or Times of Israel reporting. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No new Israeli government is approved in a Knesset confidence vote between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-15.

statement: The CME CF Bitcoin Reference Rate (BRR) prints below 65000 USD on at least one day between 2026-10-31 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 77510 USD packet quote on 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the published CME CF Bitcoin Reference Rate (BRR, 4pm London) is below 65000.00 USD on any calendar day from 2026-10-31 through 2026-11-30. Reference level at seal: 77510 USD. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The CME CF Bitcoin Reference Rate is at or above 65000 USD on every calendar day from 2026-10-31 through 2026-11-30.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite closes below 24000 on at least one trading day between 2026-11-02 and 2026-12-31. Reference: 25587.46 packet quote on 2026-10-30.
resolution: TRUE if the Nasdaq Composite official daily close (FRED series NASDAQCOM) is below 24000.00 on any trading day from 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31. Reference level at seal: 25587.46. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The Nasdaq Composite closes at or above 24000 on every trading day from 2026-11-02 through 2026-12-31.

statement: CISA adds a Drupal Commerce (Commerce Core) vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-27.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry whose vendorProject, product, or vulnerabilityName fields name Drupal and Commerce, with dateAdded between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-27 inclusive. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No KEV entry for a Drupal Commerce vulnerability carries a dateAdded between 2026-10-30 and 2026-11-27.

statement: The FBI or the US Treasury Department publicly attributes the October 2026 Binance theft to North Korean state-sponsored actors in an official release dated between 2026-10-30 and 2026-12-04.
resolution: TRUE if an official release on fbi.gov, ic3.gov, or home.treasury.gov dated between 2026-10-30 and 2026-12-04 attributes the October 2026 Binance theft to North Korean (DPRK) actors such as Lazarus or TraderTraitor. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: Neither the FBI nor the US Treasury issues an official release dated 2026-10-30 to 2026-12-04 attributing the Binance theft to North Korea.

statement: The person serving as Minister of Transport and Sustainable Mobility of Spain on 2026-10-30 leaves that office, with a Real Decreto of cese dated between 2026-10-30 and 2026-12-31 published in the Boletin Oficial del Estado.
resolution: TRUE if the BOE (boe.es) carries a Real Decreto dated between 2026-10-30 and 2026-12-31 disposing the cese of the person who was Minister of Transport and Sustainable Mobility on 2026-10-30. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: The incumbent transport minister as of 2026-10-30 remains in office through 2026-12-31 with no cese decree dated in that window.

statement: The Tennessee Supreme Court enters an order setting a new execution date for Christa Pike, with the order filed between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if a Tennessee Supreme Court order filed between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-29 sets an execution date for Christa Pike, as shown on tncourts.gov or reported by AP. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No Tennessee Supreme Court order setting an execution date for Christa Pike is filed between 2026-10-30 and 2027-01-29.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 7.5 or greater anywhere in the world with origin time between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if the USGS ComCat catalog (earthquake.usgs.gov), as listed on 2026-12-02, contains at least one event with magnitude 7.5 or greater and origin time between 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC and 2026-11-30 23:59 UTC. FALSE otherwise.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 7.5 or greater has an origin time between 2026-11-01 and 2026-11-30 UTC in the USGS catalog.
